title: PILOLCURA 100K — Torrencial Chile by UTMB 2027 race page
publisher: UTMB World Series / Torrencial Chile by UTMB
claims: The 2027 Pilolcura 100K starts on Thursday 24 June 2027 at 22:00 from Punucapa.
The official race page states a distance of 101 KM and 4,100 m of positive elevation gain.
The maximum allowed race time is 22 hours.
The official profile table lists 12 points from Start at 0 m to Finish at 101,492 m, with cumulative gain of 4,091 m and cumulative loss of 4,088 m.

The official profile distances are Las Truchas 1 6,074 m, Cafetería Oncol 24,669 m, Pililín 33,629 m, Quitaqui 43,299 m, Casa Manns 52,129 m, El Canelo 60,073 m, Las Truchas 2 73,017 m, Potreros 78,430 m, Espacio Bayo 90,708 m, El Castaño 95,905 m and Finish 101,492 m.

The official profile lists drink only at Las Truchas 1, hot food at the other nine intermediate points, medical support at ten of the twelve points, a drop bag only at Casa Manns, and power points at Cafetería Oncol, Espacio Bayo and El Castaño.
The official description says the route crosses the Coastal Range from Oncol Hill to the Pacific coast and finishes in Valdivia at dawn.
The race page lists 3 Running Stones and finals access for this race.
The page states that the top three female and top three male runners earn automatic qualification for the CCC race, while the page's meta description separately states six direct tickets to UTMB.
The four cutoff cells on the 2027 page carry 2026 dates (2026-06-28) and Sunday weekday labels, so they cannot be used as 2027 cutoff times.
The race page links a 2027 GPX file for the 101 km course.
